recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reopen only if a current active response definition reintroduces a required binding to ValueSet/adjudication-error.
issue_request: FHIR-12515 is a Published/Persuasive FM change request from DSTU2 asking to change the Adjudication error value set binding from required to example in ClaimResponse, EligibilityResponse, and ProcessResponse.
initial_application: No git commit naming FHIR-12515 was found. The closest application evidence is commit 5851b9ee36, which changed the ClaimResponse local AdjudicationError binding row from extensible to example in February 2017; the shared terminology binding was already example in the same era, and later XML-source conversion preserved example-strength bindings.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists ClaimResponse and CoverageEligibilityResponse as active FM resources, comments out ProcessResponse, and lists EligibilityResponse and ProcessResponse under removed resources. CoverageEligibilityResponse is the current successor for EligibilityResponse. ExplanationOfBenefit also uses example for the same binding, but it was not named by the issue. Community searches found no relevant Zulip or Confluence evidence changing the Jira/source conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit is needed because active current artifacts already use example strength and the retired legacy resources are outside current build scope.

related_jiras.note: The historical commit that changed ClaimResponse binding rows is labeled Tracker #10366, but Jira FHIR-10366 concerns ClaimResponse patient/encounter references rather than this binding; it was not decided here.
